text:
This might just be the ultimate self-hosting cheat sheet. 🔥

It's a massive open-source guide packed with resources for learning and getting started with self-hosted infrastructure.

Covers Docker, Kubernetes, databases, local LLMs, networking, Raspberry Pi, Home Assistant, security, dev tools, and much more.

If you've ever wanted to run your own software stack instead of relying on SaaS for everything, definitely save this one! 👇

Link: github.com/mikeroyal/Self-Hosting-Guide
